# init writes an explicit Dockerfile recipe and prints only the path on stdout
exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input init app --repository ghcr.io/acme/web --port 3000
stdout 'musher.yaml$'
! stdout 'Recipe'
stderr 'Recipe: Dockerfile Dockerfile'
exists app/musher.yaml
grep 'dockerfile: Dockerfile' app/musher.yaml
grep 'repository: ghcr.io/acme/web' app/musher.yaml
grep 'targetPort: 3000' app/musher.yaml
grep 'name: app' app/musher.yaml

# it refuses to overwrite without --force
! exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input init app --repository ghcr.io/acme/web
stderr 'already exists'
stderr '--force'

# --force overwrites; --json answers with one object
exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input --json init app --repository ghcr.io/acme/web --force
stdout '"path":'
stdout '"dockerfile":"Dockerfile"'

# several Dockerfiles need a choice when prompting is off
! exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input init multi --repository ghcr.io/acme/multi
stderr 'Found several Dockerfiles'
stderr '--dockerfile'

# no Dockerfile means buildpacks; --no-pin keeps the builder tag offline
exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input init node --repository ghcr.io/acme/node --no-pin
grep 'builderImage: paketobuildpacks/builder-jammy-base' node/musher.yaml
stderr 'detected node'

# without a repository there is nothing to write
! exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input init bare
stderr 'No image repository'

# build never guesses a recipe
! exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input build bare
stderr 'No build recipe'
stderr 'musher init'

# build --help lists its flags
exec $MUSHER_BIN --no-color --no-input build --help
stdout '--build-arg'
stdout '--secret'
stdout '--progress'
stdout '--builder'

-- app/Dockerfile --
FROM scratch
-- multi/Dockerfile --
FROM scratch
-- multi/worker.Dockerfile --
FROM scratch
-- node/package.json --
{}
-- bare/.keep --
